card.name: Words just before "night"
card.fires_on: Words and word pieces right before an expected "night" or "nights", such as "at", "each", "a", a number or "and" in phrases like "6 Nights" or "hours a night". It also fires inside "tonight" and "weeknights".

modes.label: Linking word before night
modes.description: A small word that sets up "night" next, as in "each night", "a night" or "at night".
modes.example: Try to get 8 hours of sleep (or more)<< each>> night.

modes.label: Counts of nights
modes.description: A number or "One" or "and" before "Nights" in trip lengths or titles.

modes.label: Inside night compounds
modes.description: Part of a compound word that ends in "night", such as "tonight" or "weeknights".
modes.example: On week<<n>>ights they operate Sky Vegas.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "night" or "nights" (including Chinese words for night) as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be "night", as in "at night" or "6 nights".
